title: The First Landing

objectives.text: Ask Cain Firesong what Tirisfal means
says: Tirisfal? Every apprentice in Dalaran learns that name, though few are told why.

Some twenty-seven centuries ago, the reckless spells of Dalaran let demons slip into the world. The magi of Dalaran and of Quel'Thalas formed a secret order to hunt them, and it met here, in these glades.
They poured their power into one champion, the Guardian of Tirisfal. Medivh was the last, and you know how that ended.
Their meeting place was Venomweb Vale, east of here. One of the Council made the spiders there in a mad bid to keep it private. The spiders, at least, have kept faith.

texts.details:
Before the plague I kept the parish records in Brill. Births, burials, boundary stones. I keep them still. No one has told me to stop.

There is a thing in the oldest pages that bothered me long before I died. Tirisfal is an older name than Lordaeron, and more than one people has come here, wanted something from this ground, and gone away again.

Cain Firesong, the mage here, studied in Dalaran. Ask him what the name meant to his order. Then go and look at the place he tells you of. You need not go far in.
texts.objectives: Ask Cain Firesong in Brill what the name Tirisfal means and look into Venomweb Vale, then return to Claire Willower in Brill.
texts.progress: The vale lies east along the road, south of the monastery. Keep to the near edge; the spiders are not small.
texts.completion:
So the mages met there. I had the name and never the reason.

Now the older thing. Seven thousand years ago the Highborne, exiled from across the sea, landed on this coast under Dath'Remar Sunstrider and settled in Tirisfal, among the first human tribes. They drew on the magic in this ground, and met shades of dark energy that drove some of them mad. They came to believe that something evil slept beneath the glades. It was never proven.

Dath'Remar led them north, and they founded Quel'Thalas. It is in no history of Lordaeron I ever filed, $N.

idea: Chain 1 of 2, What Sleeps Beneath: the Council of Tirisfal met in Venomweb Vale, whose spiders one of its members made; and the Highborne under Dath'Remar settled Tirisfal, met dark energies that drove some mad, and left for Quel'Thalas.
